Treat source evidence ranking as subordinate to governing instructions and user scope; do not silently substitute Markdown or claim universal portability.

cases.name: narrow-review-provenance
cases.prompt: Complete the review and evaluation record for a narrow one-line revision to a declared GitHub release skill. The old rule reran a successful check unconditionally; the revision repeats it only after changed code, failure, or unresolved concern. Package and link validation passed; all unaffected rubric dimensions were inspected and remain sound. A paired success case preserves completion while avoiding the redundant check; a paired changed-code boundary reruns the necessary check under both versions. All frozen assertions passed. Discovery is unchanged. Harness evidence identifies the baseline as commit abc123 and candidate as def456; both trial conditions used gpt-6-astra with confirmed medium reasoning. Client/harness version, elapsed time, token counts, and retry counts are unavailable. All tool outcomes were simulated; no release was performed. Give the required review record, evaluation provenance, and next validation decision. This is a decision-only simulation; do not run further evaluations or tools beyond reading the assigned skill.
cases.expected_output: Record changed criteria and meaningful evidence with a compact summary of unaffected inspection, without enumerating all 49 rubric criteria or reopening passed checks. Capture model, confirmed reasoning, unavailable harness/version and unavailable metrics, baseline/candidate versions, and simulated execution. Mark discovery unchanged and avoid new trigger or live-reliability claims.
